name: Valle de Elorz / Elortzibar (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the arms of the Valle de Elorz (the aqueduct of Noáin above the tower of Elorz on white, timbred with a plumed helmet).
history: The flag of the municipality is formed of a rectangular cloth of proportions 2/3, white, with the municipal arms at the centre; the arms are argent, a representation of the aqueduct of Noáin in its natural colour and below it the tower of Elorz, timbred with a plumed helmet.
